entries.brief: Single coherent humanoid face with teal scales and three gill slits on neck; aquatic adaptation, amber arc. Centered 70%, transparent safe margins. Painterly SKAZ encyclopedia; warm upper-left light, dark silhouette, no text or frame.

Small ochre humanoid lower-left transforms through one amber curved ribbon into a large green frog upper-right. Clear beast transformation, correct limbs, compact diagonal silhouettes, transparent margins. Painterly broad brushwork, warm light, no text or scenery.

Small ochre humanoid mage lower-left transforms through violet-gold ribbon into a golden living dragon head/neck/folded wing upper-right. Creature-to-creature, not stone-to-dragon; transparent safe margins, dark edges, warm upper-left light, no text or scene.
